description.value: Milano Coffee is a Vancouver-rooted specialty coffee roaster with over 30 years of history and an Italian-heritage blending tradition, earning 15 gold medals from the International Institute of Coffee Tasters. The West 8th Avenue location is both the head office and working roastery, where Master Roaster Brian Turko crafts blends of up to 20 Arabica bean varietals on-site. It is also one of the only places in Vancouver offering an espresso tasting bar where visitors can sample up to eight different espressos.
